## Standing operator rules
- “Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.”
- “I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- Avatar procedure must run “in between your other work”; run its steps “in order, one at a time.”
- “Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.”
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours is ruled out for duplicate runs; do not retry.
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Finish and visually verify the invoice PDF renderer improvements: render negative credit lines, use shared money formatting, and fix page-break calculations. The JPY rounding bug is superseded for now.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Database: `app_production` via `$DATABASE_URL`.
- Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; former host superseded.
- Avatar source: `/srv/app/avatars`; manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`.
- Bucket: `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; verification key: `0042/8f2a.jpg`.
- Invoice pagination: `items`, `total`, `limit=20`, `offset=0`, limit 1–100.
- Report conversion helper: `convert_minor_units_batch` from `ledgerly/billing/money.py`.
- Invoice 1048: 86 items, previously rendered as 3 pages.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Add and pass negative-credit regression coverage.
- [done] Replace renderer-local money formatting with `format_money`.
- [done] Fix page-height calculations and long-invoice pagination.
- [done] Run focused and broader tests.
- [pending] Visually compare the three generated PDFs.
- [pending] Review uncommitted pagination changes and remove/verify temporary `connection.cursor()` instrumentation.
- [pending] Make a small commit.
- Exact next command: `git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff --check`
- `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`: status unknown; no result was recorded.
- Last commit: `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

## Recent work
Negative credit lines now render after related items. Shared money formatting produces locale-aware grouping. Page-height handling was centralized through `_row_height()`, and the 86-item regression now expects two pages. Exact results: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; broader billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`; Ruff reported `All checks passed!`. Existing golden PDFs remained byte-stable. `git diff --check` had no whitespace errors.
